# Drawer

Drawer presents contextual content from an edge of the viewport without committing to a dashboard, map, or CMS-specific layout.

- **Import:** `import { Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerOverlay, DrawerPortal, DrawerTitle, DrawerTrigger } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/overlay-drawer--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Drawer,
  DrawerContent,
  DrawerDescription,
  DrawerFooter,
  DrawerHeader,
  DrawerTitle,
  DrawerTrigger,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function DrawerExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Drawer>
        <DrawerTrigger asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Open drawer</Button>
        </DrawerTrigger>
        <DrawerContent side="right">
          <DrawerHeader>
            <DrawerTitle>Manage venue layers</DrawerTitle>
            <DrawerDescription>
              Review visibility, routing, and publishing settings for this map.
            </DrawerDescription>
          </DrawerHeader>
          <div className="rounded-control border border-border bg-muted/40 p-4 text-sm">
            Drawer body content stays generic in Core. Product-specific content
            belongs in composed dashboard, SDK, or CMS components.
          </div>
          <DrawerFooter>
            <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
            <Button>Save changes</Button>
          </DrawerFooter>
        </DrawerContent>
      </Drawer>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## DrawerContent

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `Omit<DialogPrimitive.DialogContentProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "ref"> & { portalContainer?: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>["container"]; showClose?: boolean; side?: DrawerSide }`.

- `portalContainer`: `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>["container"]`, optional.
- `showClose`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.
- `side`: `DrawerSide`, optional, default `"right"`.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `forceMount`: `true`, optional.

  Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
  controlling animation with React animation libraries.

- `onEscapeKeyDown`: `(event: KeyboardEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the escape key is down.
  Can be prevented.

- `onPointerDownOutside`: `(event: PointerDownOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the a `pointerdown` event happens outside of the `DismissableLayer`.
  Can be prevented.

- `onFocusOutside`: `(event: FocusOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the focus moves outside of the `DismissableLayer`.
  Can be prevented.

- `onInteractOutside`: `(event: PointerDownOutsideEvent | FocusOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when an interaction happens outside the `DismissableLayer`.
  Specifically, when a `pointerdown` event happens outside or focus moves outside of it.
  Can be prevented.

- `onOpenAutoFocus`: `FocusScopeProps['onMountAutoFocus']`, optional.

  Event handler called when auto-focusing on open.
  Can be prevented.

- `onCloseAutoFocus`: `FocusScopeProps['onUnmountAutoFocus']`, optional.

  Event handler called when auto-focusing on close.
  Can be prevented.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Drawer

- `onOpenChange`: `(open: boolean) => void`, optional.
- `modal`: `boolean`, optional.

## Types these props take

### DrawerSide

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type DrawerSide = "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom";
```
